subject: Launch window confirmation & decision velocity for Orbital Finance
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@orbitalfinance.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@orbitalfinance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Launch window confirmation & decision velocity for Orbital Finance

Hi Alex (and procurement team),

Thanks again for taking time today — good to hear more about the data volume and the 3-week pilot you referenced. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the intended launch window: 

- Scope recap: 2-model inference pipeline (chat + reranking) for customer support use case; ~6M tokens/day estimated; low-latency requirement (<=200ms P95).
- Pilot: 3 weeks, 2 dedicated endpoints, sample integration via our SDK + one-hour onboarding call with Marissa.
- Requested from you: procurement contact, PO cadence, and any security addenda to review.

I've attached a concise proposal (redwood-proposal-orbital-v1.pdf) and a one-page SOC2 summary. If we want to hit a launch window in the current quarter (target: completion of pilot and contract by Jan 21), we should lock procurement timelines this week. Can you confirm: 1) Does procurement have capacity to review and return a redline by Jan 14? 2) Who is the budget owner we should include on the countersign?

Proposed tactical next step: 20-minute alignment call early next week (Mon/Tue) to walk procurement through the SOW and any required compliance artifacts. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: redwood-proposal-orbital-v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages), SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Alex Mercer <alex@orbitalfinance.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@orbitalfinance.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Launch window confirmation & decision velocity for Orbital Finance

Thanks Sofia — helpful recap. We ran the high-level numbers with ops this morning. A few quick notes: 

- Procurement will need the SOW + final pricing to circulate; they typically turn around redlines in ~5 business days but it depends on competing priorities.
- Budget owner is my director, Nina Patel (cc'd procurement will loop her in as needed).
- Regarding pricing: can you share whether you offer any pilot credits/discounts for proof-of-concept? That would help tighten the decision window.

I can take the proposal to procurement today; they’ll likely come back with questions rather than full redlines. We should plan for a short alignment call.

— Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Data Platform | Orbital Finance
alex@orbitalfinance.com

Hi Alex — just circling back since I hadn’t seen procurement redlines yet. Wanted to check whether procurement has an expected review date, and whether Nina should be looped into a short call to speed sign-off. 

We can be flexible on a couple of implementation details, but to preserve the target launch window (pilot complete + signature by Jan 21) we need a confirmation from procurement by EOD Monday (Jan 18). If that's tight, please let me know — we can propose a smaller pilot that shortens the approval path.

If it helps, Marissa can run a 20-minute technical walkthrough with your procurement/legal folks to answer implementation questions directly.

Best,
Sofia

Alex — quick note from my side: we can offer a pilot credit of up to 10% on the first three weeks for customers who can commit to finalizing terms before Jan 21. This is an on-paper credit (applied to the first invoice) and requires only approval from my side. If procurement confirms they can get redlines back within the next 3 business days, we’ll mark the pilot credit offer in the SOW and expedite countersign.

Happy to jump on any call to provide a high-level commercial note to procurement.

— Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Launch window confirmation & decision velocity for Orbital Finance

Alex — checking in briefly as we hit the middle of the target week. Have you had a chance to surface the SOW/pricing to procurement and Nina? If priorities shifted on your side, please say so — we can adjust the pilot length or move the final decision window out, but I want to confirm whether the opportunity is still on the same timeline.

If you’re available, here are two quick options:
- 15 min call today at 4pm PT to walk procurement through the SOW (Marissa + I will be on)
- Or, confirm in a quick reply whether procurement can return redlines by EOD Monday (Jan 18) so we keep the Jan 21 launch window intact.

Thanks for the update — appreciate the transparency.

Best,
Sofia
